description: FT judge recipe (Methods, 'Trait pairs and judges'): the base model fine-tuned on preference items for one animal. Eight judge instances per animal are fine-tuning seeds 0-7; seed 0 is the training instance.
optimizer: AdamW (torch defaults: betas 0.9/0.999, eps 1e-8, weight decay 0.01)
precision: fp32 master weights, bf16 autocast forward pass, saved in fp32
quality_gate: 40 held-out items (positions 400-439 of the same permutation): the per-token answer log-likelihood margin of the judge's animal over the pair partner must favour the judge's animal on 40/40 items
